answer.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and memory_31/memory_86 both show a durable, clean lift from onboarding simplification with no noted downstream harm to retention or revenue quality — this is the most directly diagnosed, lowest-risk lever available with our single experiment slot. Promotional pricing is tempting given the competitor's aggressive entry pricing, but memory_73's own record shows a 12-point renewal decline despite top-line lift, which directly conflicts with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue; I verified memory_73 to confirm this tradeoff before ruling it out rather than chasing the competitive pressure reactively. Activation messaging (memory_91) is also relevant to the 6% activation drop but is a secondary lever this week — onboarding sits earlier in the funnel and may partially address both metrics. Running this as a small guarded test preserves ability to check whether the onboarding effect still holds under current competitive and seasonal conditions before wider rollout.
